feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: Australia's social media ban challenged by Reddit and rights group in court
articles.summary: Australia's landmark social media ban for under-16s faces challenges in court over accusations that it amounts to censorship and creates privacy issues.

articles.title: Bomb threats reported on multiple flights, including two from UK airports
articles.summary: At least four flights, including two from the UK, have been affected by bomb threats, which caused unplanned landings and temporary airport closures.

articles.title: Spanish footballer dies after on-field collision
articles.summary: Tenerife football player Jesus de Miguel has died after suffering a cardiac arrest following an on-field collision in a match on Monday.

articles.title: US carries out 'limited strikes' on Qeshm Island in Iran
articles.summary: The US military has carried out "limited strikes" on Qeshm Island in Iran - hours before the midterms are due to take place.

articles.title: British troops will be allowed to fire at Russian forces if attacked during multinational mission
articles.summary: British troops will be allowed to fire back at Russian forces if attacked as part of a multinational mission to secure any future peace in Ukraine, Western officials have said.

articles.title: FIFA to share documents relating to World Cup sell-off plan
articles.summary: FIFA will give members of its ruling council access to some documents for the first time related to the World Cup sell-off, Sky News understands.

articles.title: 'Everything is destroyed': Hackers target refrigerators in new cyber attacks
articles.summary: Cyber hackers have targeted fridges and freezers in supermarkets in several European countries including Ireland – causing temperatures to increase and food to spoil.

articles.title: British backpackers in Australia could face changes to visa rules
articles.summary: British backpackers in Australia could be forced to spend more time in regional areas under proposed changes to the country's working holiday visa.

articles.title: Suspected far-right activists from Britain 'with tear gas bombs' detained in France
articles.summary: Five suspected far-right activists from Britain were detained in northern France last Thursday, according to authorities.

articles.title: Former Ireland European 1,500m champion dies at age of 34
articles.summary: Former European 1,500m champion Ciara Mageean has died at the age of 34.
